Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: First passive SpEffect of the talisman, applied while it is equipped. Only used when Reference Type is 2 (SpEffect); with any other type this field gives nothing.

Fields.Name: SFX Variation ID
Fields.Description: Specify SFX variation (used to identify SFX in combination with TimeActEditor ID)

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: How much the accessory weighs

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Action ID (= Skill)

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: How much it sells for

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Inventory sort order.

Fields.Name: QWC ID
Fields.Description: The ID this item uses for world tendency.

Fields.Name: Equip Model ID
Fields.Description: Equipment model number

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Level that can be sold at the store

Fields.Name: Achievement Grade ID
Fields.Description: The achievement ID this part is associated with, if any.

Fields.Name: Achievement Sequential ID
Fields.Description: Trophy SEQ number

Fields.Name: Equip Model Category
Fields.Description: Equipment model type

Fields.Name: Equip Model Gender
Fields.Description: Gender of equipment model

Fields.Name: Accessory Category
Fields.Description: Equipment category. Only 0 (Talisman) is mapped to the talisman equip slots when the game works out where the item can be equipped.

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: What Reference ID points to. Only 2 (SpEffect) is used: Reference ID is then applied as a passive SpEffect.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Since there are effects (enchantment weapons, etc.) whose parameters fluctuate depending on skills, magic, items, etc., set each action so that the determined effect can correspond to the effect such as power up only weapon attack. Set None for items that do not need to be set, such as varistor.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: No vagrant 0: No lottery 1 ~: With lottery

Fields.Name: Vagrant Bonus Enemy Drop Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: No drop 0: No lottery 1 ~: With lottery

Fields.Name: Vagrant Enemy Drop Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: No drop 0: No lottery 1 ~: With lottery

Fields.Name: Can Store in Chest
Fields.Description: Can it be put in the storage box

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed on Unequip
Fields.Description: Is destroyed when unequipped.

Fields.Name: Cannot Drop for Others
Fields.Description: A dropped copy can't be shared with other players in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Can Discard
Fields.Description: Can it be discarded

Fields.Name: Can Drop
Fields.Description: Can it be dropped

Fields.Name: Shop Price
Fields.Description: Default shop price: a shop lineup row whose own price is negative uses this value instead (still scaled and offset by that row's price multiplier and addition). -1 also makes one shop menu check reject the item.

Fields.Name: Accessory Group
Fields.Description: If two accessories have the same Group Id they cannot be equipped at the same time

Fields.Name: Pledge Type
Fields.Description: The pledge type that can use this accessory.

Fields.Name: Completion Achievement ID
Fields.Description: SEQ number of complete trophy

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [1]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped, alongside Reference ID and the other passive SpEffects.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [2]
Fields.Description: Second additional SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [3]
Fields.Description: Third additional SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [4]
Fields.Description: Fourth additional SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped.
